name: Tier 1: NIFTY
note: Instruments the engine keeps subscribed at all times, whether or not a page shows them, so every session is journaled. mode: ticker (last price), quote (adds volume, VWAP, day OHLC, buy/sell quantity) or full (adds OI and depth). Indices carry no volume, so ticker is enough for them. NIFTY futures follow once the instrument download includes futures.
